title: Filipino-Style Fried Rice with Garlic Gyoza
description: A flavorful and filling meal of crispy garlic gyoza served atop a savory fried rice dish, inspired by the bold flavors of the Philippines.

ingredients.name: garlic gyoza
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: fried rice
ingredients.notes: preferably leftover from a previous meal

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add 10-12 garlic gyoza to the skillet and fry until crispy and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the fried gyoza from the skillet and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and stir-fry the cooked fried rice for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Season the fried rice with salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste.
Serve the fried rice hot, topped with the crispy garlic gyoza, chopped green onions, and additional garlic powder if desired.
